flash_attention.resolution: Original kernels.get_kernel default resolution; network access or an existing compatible hub cache is needed. No cached revision/binary is bundled or claimed pinned by uv.lock.

notes: uv.lock and pyproject.toml are copied byte-for-byte from the measured frozen source; use--locked so dependency resolution cannot silently change.
uv chooses the CUDA12.8 Torch wheel via extra gpu; do not install the CPU extra at the same time.
uv and a working NVIDIA driver are external prerequisites. No curl-pipe installation or credential setup is included.
The original pyproject references README.md; retain the publication README alongside it.
Prepared dataset/tokenizer identity is checked against input-manifest.json. Existing content is never silently substituted for a mismatch.
